notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
I know you have been waiting for quite some time ) 
Arkos 2 will be released May 01, 2025 around 1:00 AM PDT

See ya!

notes.title: Devlog April 2024
notes.content:
Hey, everybody!

A bit of news about Arkos 2 development. Right now I'm finishing the last fifth episode and after that I'll start doing all the other stuff (marketing, music, story)

I've added fresh screenshots from the game to the main page and prepared a small teaser so you can see what the worlds look like:

[previewyoutube=l0LC01UVsqs;full][/previewyoutube]

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Voxels On AIR!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I will be live streaming Arkos II Demo with a quick QA session and also show of some levels not included in demo!

Feel free to wishlist Arkos II, so you don't miss the launch!

Cheers!
